# The task: Guest checkout
Let people buy without creating an account. Ask for an email so they get the receipt.

# Your job
Compose the plan for this task: which roles work on it, on which profiles, in what order. Read the repository enough to judge the size of the work, but change nothing.

Roles you can use:
- researcher (Researcher): Finds out what users expect and how others solved it before anything is designed. | read-only | hands back: Research notes with sources. | fits: a "do" stage

- design-reviewer (Design reviewer): Challenges the design until nothing blocking is left. | read-only | hands back: Objections, each blocking or not. | fits: the reviewer of a "converge" stage
- ux-designer (UX designer): Shapes the screens and the words users will see. | read-only | hands back: UI notes and screen sketches. | fits: a "do" stage
- builder (Builder): Implements the design in its own working copy and keeps the tests green. | changes the product | hands back: A change ready for review and a plain-language summary of it. | fits: a "do" stage
- tester (Tester): Runs the product like a user and checks every acceptance item. | read-only | hands back: A result per acceptance item, with the scenario and observed evidence, or a reason it could not be verified. | fits: a "do" stage
- code-reviewer (Code reviewer): Tries to prove the change is not done. Pass or fail, never a score. | read-only | hands back: Findings, each pass or fail with where it is and the evidence. | fits: a reviewer in a "review-chain" stage

- opus-high: Claude Code running Opus 5.5 at high effort
